parts:

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Folders with Number of individuals
parts:
Dear Bernat,
you are right, this directory structure is not supported currently.
Did you already create a record table from your directory structure, to which you would like to add the number of individuals? Or is there a problem in creating the record table already?
Given a record table, it should be possible to extract the information from the directories that are included in the record tables. I assumeyou want the last part of the directory? Can you provide an example path please?
Something like this should get the last part of the path specified in the "Directory" column. This bit of code assumes your record table is called "records".

records$n_individuals <- unlist(sapply(records$Directory, FUN = function(x) {
  tmp <- unlist(strsplit(x, split = "/", fixed = TRUE))
  tmp[length(tmp)]
}
)
)

If this doesn't work, please provide more detail on what you have already.
Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: Folders with Number of individuals
parts:
Hi Jürgen, hi all
I finally decided to move all files to the Species Folder (from the "number-of-individuals-per-species" folder). Now everything seems to work well (recorTable,....). Here's the script I have used to move all files, in case some of you needs it someday:

wd<-("YOUR_FOLDER_OF PICTURES")
dirStat<-list.files(wd, full.names = TRUE)                   
for (i in 1:length(dirStat)){                                            #in each Station
  dirCamInStat<-list.files(dirStat[i], full.names = TRUE)
  for (j in 1:length(dirCamInStat)){                                 #in each Camera
    dirSpsInCam<-list.files(dirCamInStat[j], full.names = TRUE)
    for (k in 1:length(dirSpsInCam)){                               #in each Species
      dirNumIndPerSpecies<-list.files(dirSpsInCam[k], full.names = TRUE)
      for (y in 1:length(dirNumIndPerSpecies)){                #in each NumberPerSpecies
        origFolder<-list.files(dirNumIndPerSpecies[y], full.names=TRUE, recursive=TRUE)
        destFolder<-dirSpsInCam[k]
        file.copy(origFolder, destFolder, copy.date = TRUE)
        unlink(dirNumIndPerSpecies[y], recursive = TRUE)     #delete the NumberOfSpecies folder
      }#endNumberPerSpecies
    }#end Species
  }#end Camera
} #end Station

Best
Bernat
